name: NGC 4423 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4423, an edge-on spiral galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4423-hubble
story: It can look like an irregular streak, but NGC 4423 is a spiral galaxy seen edge-on, so its spiral arms are hidden from view. Hubble looked here as part of a study of dwarf galaxies in the Virgo Cluster that are being stripped of their gas.

claims.text: NGC 4423 is a spiral galaxy seen edge-on, so its spiral arms can't be seen
NGC 4423 is a dwarf galaxy in the Virgo Cluster targeted by HST program 17240
The program studies dwarf galaxies in clusters undergoing ram pressure stripping
